name: schedulerKit
description: Cooperative, frame-budgeted scheduling with priorities, cancellation scopes, and delayed work.
summary: Cooperative, frame-budgeted scheduling with priorities, cancellation scopes and TimerKit delays.

Coalescing.description: Debounce and Coalesce handles on the facade and on scopes, with the coalescing family's shared clock, member links and protected delivery.

Lanes.description: Named lanes that ration a resource: in-flight and interval limits, retries with backoff, and Debounce or Coalesce delivery through a lane.

Watch.description: Watch: poll a predicate on a shared per-interval ticker and call back when its result changes.
